title: IBM OM crossbar supervised retraining writer-debug comparison
hypothesis: The limited recovery of the completed supervised_ce_pulse_adam arm is caused by its open-loop Bernoulli one-pulse writer rather than by cross-entropy backpropagation or insufficient network capacity. Starting from bit-exact healthy and immediate-fault states, one fixed 55,000-example epoch of ordinary label-supervised continuous-shadow Adam followed by a single closed-loop same-array program-and-verify pass will achieve at least 95% mean apparent-forward accuracy on the held-out endpoints 89403-89405, improve all three endpoints from their immediate-fault states, and finish within two percentage points of their healthy mean. Endpoint 89402 is development evidence because it was used to diagnose and select this correction.
motivation: The artifact-verified open-loop pulse-Adam study recovered the mean network from 82.050% to 89.175%, but exact endpoint-89402 replay showed that its terminal model degrades after a mid-epoch peak. Manual and continuous-weight controls verified the BP gradient and reached above 96%, while no-mask continuous-shadow retraining followed by closed-loop P&V reached 95.7%. This study reruns the old writer and the corrected retrain-then-reprogram writer from a common chronological fault bundle so the source of the gap can be tested without changing the network, data, or fault realization.

arms.description: The preserved supervised_ce_pulse_adam arm: one 55,000-example CE/BP epoch whose per-minibatch Adam commands are independently Bernoulli-rounded to at most one open-loop physical pulse per cell.
One fixed continuous-shadow CE/Adam epoch over the same 55,000 examples, followed only at the final epoch by closed-loop one-pulse apparent-verify programming onto the same faulted plant.

completion_criteria: Both declared configs complete exactly once on the 784-50-10 analog-MVM--digital-ReLU--analog-MVM network, source assignment 87004, endpoint seeds 89402-89405, the same five one-minibatch continuous-HWA predeployment path, the first 1000 official MNIST test examples, and no fresh-array transfer or accuracy-based checkpoint selection.

Before recovery, both arms have byte- or tensor-hash-equivalent teacher/source q, healthy and published-companion populations, HWA initial/final states, per-endpoint P&V persistent/apparent states and pulse counters, fault masks, stuck q vectors, immediate-fault persistent/apparent states, predictions, and fault-transition receipts. Any mismatch invalidates the writer comparison.

The published companion explicitly enables IBM-OM corrupt_devices_prob=0.1348 despite the AIHWKit preset default 0.0 and retains corrupt_devices_range=0.01. It contains the same collapsed active states and zero pulse increments in both arms. Stuck-site persistent q=a-r remains bit-exact during recovery, while commanded stuck sites may resample apparent write noise.

Both recovery learners use exactly the same ordered 55,000-example ground-truth-label cohort in 3438 seed-42 minibatches, full-network CE autograd/backpropagation including W2 transpose, Adam betas 0.9/0.999, epsilon 1e-8, and all layers. Neither update helper receives teacher logits or the fault mask; predeployment HWA remains restricted to its original deterministic 16-example stream.

The preserved open-loop arm retains q learning rates [6e-5,6e-5], independent per-minibatch Bernoulli one-pulse conversion, the 64-command per-cell cap, and no residual, shadow, verify, early stopping, or retuning. Its report identifies commands rather than claiming every command changed persistent q.

The corrected arm initializes an FP32 q shadow from the exact immediate-fault apparent state, keeps every coordinate trainable, uses logical-weight Adam rates [1e-3,1e-3] converted to q rates by the frozen deployment digital scales, clamps only to the healthy source support, and never receives published fault bounds or a fault mask. It performs no physical writes during the epoch and uses the fixed final shadow without validation selection.

After shadow training, the corrected arm performs exactly one same-array P&V pass with the predeclared one-pulse apparent-verify controller, deployment verify tolerance, and 128-pulse per-cell cap. The controller receives the shadow target and observable read/command interface but no defect map. It reports target and state hashes, accepted/exhausted/nonfinite cells, reads, pulses, reversals, commands to immutable/programmable cells, actual healthy persistent movement, and stuck-site persistent immutability.

Every endpoint reports healthy, immediate-fault, shadow-only, and final programmed apparent-forward accuracy where applicable; final persistent-q diagnostic accuracy; CE; prediction and tensor hashes; data provenance; optimizer steps; and writer accounting. Endpoint 89402 is development-only. Endpoints 89403-89405 are the primary untouched cohort.

The result remains exploratory model evidence. The corrected arm is a privileged off-array retrain-then-reprogram ceiling with FP32 shadow weights, autograd, digital Adam, labels, and verify reads; it is not a fully on-chip learner. Four write streams on one assignment are not independent arrays, and post-write apparent accuracy does not establish fresh-read, retention, drift, line-resistance, endurance, or fabricated-hardware robustness.
analysis_plan: Apply provenance, chronology, learner-interface, and cohort gates before accuracy. If the two arms do not have exact healthy/immediate-fault semantic parity, if either recovery learner sees the fault mask or teacher logits, or if the ordered 55,000-example streams differ, classify the comparison invalid.

Designate endpoint 89402 as development because it selected the correction. On held-out endpoints 89403-89405, report each healthy, immediate-fault, old-writer final, shadow-only, and corrected programmed apparent accuracy; arithmetic means and ranges; fault damage; recovery gain; recovery fraction; corrected-minus-old paired difference; and distance from healthy.

Support the primary hypothesis only if the corrected held-out mean final apparent accuracy is at least 95%, every held-out endpoint improves from immediate fault, and the corrected held-out mean is no more than two percentage points below the healthy held-out mean. Do not substitute the development endpoint or round a failing threshold upward.

Report the corresponding all-four-endpoint values only as secondary descriptive metrics. Compare the preserved old arm against its previous artifact-verified run to detect implementation drift, but do not reuse old result files as though they were part of this run.

Use the continuous-shadow result to separate learning capacity from array realization. Report shadow-to-programmed loss, P&V acceptance and exhaustion, and apparent/persistent gaps. A high post-write apparent result with weak persistent q is an endpoint-conditioned repair that still requires fresh-read and retention tests.

Verify that the shadow optimizer attempted to train every coordinate without a mask and that physical stuck-site q stayed immutable. Separate P&V commands to immutable and programmable cells and actual movement of healthy cells; a stuck-site command is not repair of that site.

Do not tune the logical learning rate, epoch count, P&V tolerance/cap, data order, development designation, or final checkpoint after observing the held-out results. Any mixed-precision residual writer, multiple-epoch schedule, native AIHWKit BL31 analog-SGD arm, or fresh-read control requires a separately declared study.
